name: Temporary Residence for the Purpose of Study

requirements.blocker_text: Registered at an educational institution seated in Slovakia.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to a Slovak educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Under 20 for secondary-school study, under 23 for post-secondary/university study.
Documented proof of sufficient financial means for the stay.

outcome.duration_length: for the foreseen length of studies, up to 6 years, renewable in increments of up to 5 years

sources.title: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs, EU Immigration Portal -- Slovakia student residence: enrollment at a Slovak institution, age caps (under 20 secondary / under 23 post-secondary), financial means, duration up to 6 years (5-year renewal increments), work rights capped at 10 hours/week (non-university) or 20 hours/week (university) without a separate work permit; 90-day grace period before residence permit required if reporting to Foreign Police within 3 working days

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovakia). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to the European Commission's own EU Immigration Portal (tier-2 intergovernmental, treated consistently with this dataset's use of EU-institution sources elsewhere e.g. Romania's Schengen-status corroboration), which describes Slovakia's national rules in detail rather than generic EU policy -- Slovakia's own minv.sk pages could not be fetched to sufficient depth in this pass to independently corroborate at tier-1, so this stays draft despite the detailed, specific content. work_rights is 'restricted' reflecting the sourced 10hr/20hr weekly caps (a genuine, specific limitation, not a conservative default). The age caps (20/23) are an unusual, specific structural feature worth flagging -- most other countries' student routes in this dataset do not cap applicant age.
